```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(liana)
library(nichenetr)
library(Seurat)
library(ggrepel)
library(cowplot)
library(readxl)
```

```{r setup}
if(Sys.getenv("POSITRON") == "1"){
    setwd(here::here())
    params <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)$params
}
```

```{r}
source("./pipe.R")
input = pipeline$run_liana$input
output = pipeline$run_liana$output
```


```{r}
acc_cancer_cells = readRDS(input$cancer)
acc_caf_cells =  readRDS(input$caf_with_subtypes)
t_cells_labled =  readRDS(input$t_cells_labled)
immune_with_cell_types = readRDS(input$immune_with_cell_types)
```

```{r}
# aggregate T cells for only CD4, CD8, Tregs, and gamma delta T cells
# change the cell_type column to reflect this aggregation
t_cells_labled$cell_type <- case_when(
  t_cells_labled$cell_type %in% c("CD4_EM", "CD4_CM", "CD4_Naive") ~ "CD4_T",
  t_cells_labled$cell_type %in% c("CD8_CM", "CD8_Naive", "CD8_TEMRA", "CD8_EM") ~ "CD8_T"
  TRUE ~ t_cells_labled$cell_type
)
```

```{r}
for (patient in unique(acc_cancer_cells$orig.ident)) {
  print(paste0("Running LIANA for patient: ", patient))
  # Subset the Seurat objects for the current patient
  data_per_patient = subset(acc_cancer_immune_caf, subset = orig.ident == patient)
  data = subset(data_per_patient, subset = cell_type %in% c("Luminal", "Myo","CD4_T", "CD8_T",
                                                "gdT", "Treg","Myeloid Dendritic", "Macrophages", "Basophils", "Neutrophils" ))
  # Run LIANA for the current patient
  liana_results <- liana_wrap(data) %>%
  liana_aggregate()
  # Save the results for the current patient
  saveRDS(object = liana_results,file =  paste0(params$data_out_dir, patient,"liana_result.RDS"))
}




}
```



```{r}
#aggregate Lunminal and Myoepithelial cells into just cancer cells
acc_cancer_cells$cell_type <- case_when(
  acc_cancer_cells$cell_type %in% c("Luminal", "Myo") ~ "Cancer",
  TRUE ~ acc_cancer_cells$cell_type
)

```


```{r}
for (patient in unique(acc_cancer_cells$orig.ident)) {
  print(paste0("Running LIANA for patient: ", patient))
  # Subset the Seurat objects for the current patient
  data_per_patient = subset(acc_cancer_immune_caf, subset = orig.ident == patient)
  data = subset(data_per_patient, subset = cell_type %in% c("Cancer", "CD4_T", "CD8_T",
                                                "gdT", "Treg","Myeloid Dendritic", "Macrophages", "Basophils","Neutrophils" ))
  # Run LIANA for the current patient
  liana_results <- liana_wrap(data) %>%
    liana_aggregate()
  # Save the results for the current patient
  saveRDS(object = liana_results,file =  paste0(params$data_out_dir, patient,"liana_result_CD45-cancer.RDS"))

}
```

# CAF immune interactions


```{r}
for (patient in unique(acc_caf_cells$orig.ident)) {
  print(paste0("Running LIANA for patient: ", patient))
  # Subset the Seurat objects for the current patient
  data_per_patient = subset(acc_caf_cells, subset = orig.ident == patient)
  data = subset(data_per_patient, subset = cell_type %in% c("CAF", "CD4_T", "CD8_T",
                                                "gdT", "Treg","Myeloid Dendritic", "Macrophages", "Basophils","Neutrophils" ))
  # Run LIANA for the current patient
  liana_results <- liana_wrap(data) %>%
    liana_aggregate()
  # Save the results for the current patient
  saveRDS(object = liana_results,file =  paste0(params$data_out_dir, patient,"liana_result_CD45-caf.RDS"))
}
```
